en:
With this new evidence...let's look back
at <CLT=cltSTRONG>Rantaro's murder<CLT=cltNORMAL>.

The night of the incident, Kaede and I
were in the <CLT=cltSTRONG>1st floor classroom<CLT=cltNORMAL>.

We were waiting for the mastermind to
trigger the trap we set in the <CLT=cltSTRONG>library<CLT=cltNORMAL>.

Around that time, there were four people in
the <CLT=cltSTRONG>dining hall<CLT=cltNORMAL>...including the <CLT=cltSTRONG>mastermind<CLT=cltNORMAL>.

The mastermind was probably irritated
that no murders had yet occurred.

After the motive was given, they knew
that Kaede was planning something...

But the mastermind wanted some insurance.
They would take action, if necessary.

The mastermind excused themself from
the dining hall and went to the bathroom.

And from there, to the <CLT=cltSTRONG>hidden room in the
library that only the mastermind could enter<CLT=cltNORMAL>.
And there...they waited.

With less than an hour before the time limit
expired, Rantaro <CLT=cltSTRONG>moved the library's bookcase<CLT=cltNORMAL>...
...which set off the <CLT=cltSTRONG>receiver<CLT=cltNORMAL> I was holding.

It all happened the way we determined
in the first trial...except at the end...

I ran out of the room, and Kaede rolled the
<CLT=cltSTRONG>shot put ball<CLT=cltNORMAL> into the <CLT=cltSTRONG>air vent<CLT=cltNORMAL>.

At the same time, Rantaro was lured by
the <CLT=cltSTRONG>flash<CLT=cltNORMAL> of the hidden camera Kaede set.

He unwittingly stepped right
into the path of the shot.

The shot rolled down the <CLT=cltSTRONG>path<CLT=cltNORMAL> Kaede made,
and then...

...fell right onto Rantaro's head, killing
him instantly...or so we thought.

It turns out, that was just what the
mastermind <CLT=cltSTRONG>wanted us to believe<CLT=cltNORMAL>.

In reality, Kaede's murder plan happened
quite differently.

The shot put ball that Kaede rolled
<CLT=cltSTRONG>didn't actually hit<CLT=cltNORMAL> Rantaro.

...He must have been surprised, seeing a
shot put ball drop out of nowhere like that.
But his fate was sealed.

The <CLT=cltSTRONG>mastermind<CLT=cltNORMAL> saw that Kaede's plan
failed, and stepped in to finish the job.

The mastermind jumped out of the hidden room
and <CLT=cltSTRONG>attacked Rantaro from behind<CLT=cltNORMAL>!

And in their hand, the real murder
weapon—their own shot put ball.

Rantaro wasn't killed by Kaede's shot,
but by the <CLT=cltSTRONG>mastermind's<CLT=cltNORMAL>.

The mastermind <CLT=cltSTRONG>picked up Kaede's shot<CLT=cltNORMAL>
and left <CLT=cltSTRONG>their shot put ball<CLT=cltNORMAL> at the scene.

They also looted the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Survivor Perk Monopad<CLT=cltNORMAL>
from Rantaro's body.

Those things in hand, they retreated
back into the hidden room.

I remember seeing the bookcase closing
just as Kaede and I got there.

The mastermind had probably
just finished their crime.

And so, the real truth was perfectly hidden
from us. We went to the class trial...

...and reached the "truth" that Kaede was
the culprit.

But that <CLT=cltSTRONG>truth had been twisted<CLT=cltNORMAL>
by the mastermind!

After the murder, the mastermind left the stolen
Monopad on the <CLT=cltSTRONG>table<CLT=cltNORMAL> in the hidden room...

and threw Kaede's shot put ball
into the <CLT=cltSTRONG>trashcan<CLT=cltNORMAL>.

A little careless of them...to not
get rid of all the evidence.

They probably believed no one would ever
get into that room. But we did.

Their crime complete, the mastermind went
back through the <CLT=cltSTRONG>hidden passageway<CLT=cltNORMAL>.

The passageway led from the hidden room
all the way to...
...the <CLT=cltSTRONG>girls bathroom on the first floor<CLT=cltNORMAL>!

While the mastermind was pretending to use
the girls bathroom...
...they were actually using the hidden passageway.

That's how they moved around without being
noticed.

Anyone could have used the hidden passageway,
not just the people in the dining hall.

But looking at the survivors...only you could
possibly be the mastermind.
If I'm wrong...please, refute me.

Please tell us you aren't the mastermind,
<CLT=cltSTRONG>Tsumugi Shirogane, the Ultimate Cosplayer<CLT=cltNORMAL>!
